'hypodense' does not contradict it and the lesion is worked up either way); 'Increased colonic diverticulosis' vs 'Colonic diverticulosis': no error (the comparison difference is scored upstream (Stage 3a)); 'Large hiatal hernia' vs 'Moderate hiatal hernia': severity minor (large vs moderate hiatal hernia; one step, same management); 'Left inguinal hernia containing fat' vs 'Inguinal hernia': no error (the side is scored upstream (Stage 3a laterality)); 'Colonic mass' vs 'Sigmoid colon mass': site major (pred leaves out the sigmoid location of the colonic mass; the segment sets the endoscopic and surgical approach).
